reviews.comment: Wasn't helpful when I needed her. Because of her she made me change my major. Can not believe shes still a professor
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof Geismar is great. Her exams can be tricky, but you get the hang of it and learn what and how to study. She is willing to help if you don't understand something. Attendance isn't necessary, but she has pop quizzes, so you should show up.
I love Mrs. Geismar. She is the best nutrition professor at TAMU!
Had her for 203 and 301- a lot easier for 301. Very knowledge about the subject and makes it fun and interesting. Highlights important info in class.

One of my favorite professors at A&M. I have taken her for 203, 404, and 407. (A in 203 and B in 404/407) She has a clear passion for nutrition, which makes class very engaging. Assignments are very helpful for learning the material with helpful feedback when you get your grade. Tests are fair, study the learning objectives and you'll do great!

To me, her class was quite easy. All you need to study is specified in her learning objectives. Just know the general concepts for the multiple choice portion. For the written part, be able to see a definition and recall the word and its spelling; easy A. However, if you try to cram all chapters the night before, you probably won't do as good.

Mrs Geismar truly cares about her students and wants them to do well. Although I struggled in the beginning, she was very helpful. The information is all there in the lecture, it's just up to you to pay attention to your notes. I would recommend her to anyone and everyone.

Exams are extremely specific, you really need to know every PowerPoint slide to get an A in the course. Pop quizzes in class are not difficult can work with people around you. Very sweet lady, but you need to know and understand EVERYTHING to get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Geismar is a very sweet person. However, it is very hard to study for this class because of how specific and tricky her exam questions are. Each chapter contained about 50-80 slides and each exam covered 4-5 chapters. Exam contained mc and free response. No curves, no extra credit either. Her pop quizzes are open note, but also super tricky.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof Geismar is nice and passionate about what she teaches but her grading makes the class almost impossible. She asks about every small detail in exams and for projects, her instructions arent clear, she just gives information & you do what you can with it. I studied for more than 8 hours for all of her exams and barely passed each of them :/
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Great teacher all around really loves what she is doing but makes the class way harder than its supposed to be. Even studying hard barely got me to pass each test. Each question requires you to study the learning objectives very intently where you cant just know the gist of a definition. Feels more like a bio class but without the lab.

If youre the type to learn well from someone who just lectures with little visuals, go for her. If you hate lectures, avoid like the plague. She just goes on and on into too much detail and exams are about singular details she may mention. Questions are written confusing to throw us off on purpose. No backtracking on exams for no valid reason.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You can tell Dr. Geismar really loves what she teaches, I loved how passionate she was about the course. Her lectures were very easy to follow... Some were a bit long, but were very useful for quizzes and tests. With it being an online course, the difficulty of the class really depends on how well you can self pace yourself.

This course was AMAZING!!!! Easy to fall behind on the material because the lectures were pre-recorded. I found most of the information interesting, but some lectures were very long. Very sweet lady. Cares a lot about students and gave extra credit when the majority of us missed a quiz question. Great course that everyone should take if they can!!

Ms. Geismar is incredibly sweet. Her quizzes and tests can be tricky, but if you know the material, you will do great. Her lectures are easy to follow (she gives the powerpoint with blanks AKA fill-in-the-blank notes). She makes herself very available. If the class struggles with a quiz or test, she gives extra credit quizzes to boast grades.

Professor Geismar means well and is extremely nice in interacting with her students but her class is just way too much content. Her lectures drone on and on about way more material than you can imagine making studying for tests extremely difficult. Quizzes aren't bad and open note and two case study assignments were also easy to complete.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very sweet lady at heart and was very willing to work with students but lectures are extremely boring at times and powerpoint are filled with excessive amounts of material so get ready to study up before exams. Quizzes aren't bad and she drops the lowest one.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: She really lives up to her name Karen. She changed the times of the exam for the online class nearly 3 weeks into the semester, and wouldn't allow exceptions for any extracurricular conflicts that this caused, even though the syllabus clearly stated when the exams would be. Her lectures are long and boring and she doesn't care about her students.

Professor Geismar is a wonderful instructor. She is extremely knowledgeable and wants her students to learn. It is definitely a class where you need to study; however, she explicitly gives you the concepts you need to know. This course was transferred online due to COVID. As an online class, it was tough to stay engaged, but testing was easier.

AMAZING! Literally the best class I took during SPRING 2020. Ms. Geismar is honestly one of the most caring teachers and she made the information easy and fun to learn. Lots of Pop Quizzes but all open notes. Test question was straight forward and based on a list of "learning objectives" at the start of each presentation.
Professor Geismar is an amazing prof who makes sure everyone knows the material! Exams cover a lot of material so you definitely have to study. She's a very sweet lady and I loved her class!

Ms. Geismar obviously cares about the material, but she assigned MORE THAN DOUBLE the amount of work as the other NFSC 481 seminar professor. Not only that, but she is extremely nit picky on the presentation and final paper. Too much work for the class level. Attendance is mandatory; you'll drop an entire letter grade if you don't go.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was really enjoyable and I wasn't interested in Nutrition. She made the class interesting and I looked forward to going to class. The tests are kind of difficult because they are specific but in class she tells you what slides to put a star by to study for the exam and gives you learning objectives to study. Diet analysis project is easy
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I LOVE THIS PROF!! She is so adorable, and I loved this class. I personally love nutrition, so this class was enjoyable for me. There's A LOT of memorization, and she takes attendance. She is such a great prof, and going to class really helps to understand. Do not study the night before, you gotta put in work. The tests are hard but reasonable.

Geismar is one of my favorite profs at A&M. She makes the lectures very interesting, shes super sweet, and she gives bonus points back on the tests. Attendance isn't mandatory but there are pop quizzes you need to be in class to take.

Quizlet will be your best friend. All her tests are based on her powerpoints, mostly memorization. Assigns online post lecture quizzes that are easy, and occasionally does open note/open class "pop" quizzes that are easy and require a clicker. Three tests, a project, and final. Project is super easy, but pay attention to detail. DOnt bomb first tes
TAKE THIS PROF!!! I loved her. She made lectures fun and her exams are so easy! Just study the learning objectives she gives you and it will be an easy A

Good prof, but you have to study a TON to make an A on the tests. There is ALOT of material to study for each test (about 5 chapters each). I studied the learning obj's and still only made high B's. Ended up with an 88 in class, so I'm disappointed. Does not offer any extra credit, "the grade you get is the grade you earned." -direct quote from her
Geismar is a very sweet professor, but she gives a bunch of learning objectives and expects you to know all of them for the test. It is not an easy A. You have to study A LOT outside of class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Geismar is SO SWEET, but her class is sooo hard. She gives way too much information to study and only gives you 50 questions on the test... so you study WAY MORE than you actually need to. If you are one to completely devote ALL your time into one class, then take it. If not, DON'T!!!

Attendance is mandatory (clicker questions, pop quizzes) and she doesn't post lecture notes online. Tests cover a lot of material and take a while to study for, but she tells you exactly what to study for the test so as long as you study the objectives you'll do fine. Really sweet professor and obviously cares about her students.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Geismar is so sweet and i loved listening to her lectures, but beware because her tests are tough and the class isn't an easy A. You have to know everything inside and out so definitely study at least a week or so in advance. Many people struggled but the key is really to just study each learning obj. and know them all 100%.
Geismar is a good teacher. You have to go to class to fill in the powerpoint notes. The tests are facts based, but a lot of material and information.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Loved this class and the professor! Powerpoints are lengthy and do require a lot of time to study if you want an A.  Go to her office hours to see each test.  This is super helpful, as a lot of questions will show up on final. Take notes after seeing test to look back on!! Go to class, there is 5 pop quizes and 3 are used as extra points.

I took Dr. Geismar's class expecting it to be pretty simple. I know that some people did fine, but I actually struggled with it in the beginning. The trick is that you really have to study for her exams, as they are pretty detailed and the questions are worded in an attempt to trick you. Don't take it as lightly as I did!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: GREAT professor! She makes it clear to study the learning objectives for the exam, and that is really the key to an A. Reading the chapters before class helps with clarification (easy read) and clicker points and pop quizzes are easy points to get. Tests are detailed, but STRAIGHT from learning obj so DO THEM AND ASK QUESTIONS ABOUT THEM!!
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor! Yes there is a lot of material, but attend class and pay attention & it's definitely manageable. Her lectures are straightforward and out of the book so its easy to get supplemental explanation if you cant make office hours. Studying and attendance are important. One of my favorite classes, and professors!
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Unless you absolutely have to, don't take Geismar. Her lectures are long, boring, and basically straight out of the textbook anyway. She gives you literally hundreds of "learning objectives" that you're supposed to memorize the answers to for each test, then tests over tiny details instead of the overall objective. And she loves tricky questions.

Overall, I enjoyed Geismar's class. The lectures had a lot of information, but she always starred the material that we needed to know for the test. Attendance isn't necessary, but if you want to know the specific topics being tested, you need to attend lecture. The class is mostly memorization, but put in some effort and an A shouldn't be hard!

Professor Geismar is probably one of my favorite professors I have had at A&M. If you study, actually put effort into the mid-semester project, and attend class for her many I-Clicker bonus point quizzes, you will have no problem passing the class. sure GO IN TO OFFICE HOURS AFTER A TEST!! A good # of the questions/subjects repeat on the final ;)

She is not good at lecturing: talks way to fast, and is very confusing. Way too much detailed information for an intro nutrition class. Short answer and fill in the blank tests. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.

Expects us to memorize 400 detailed slides for each test, and then tests on the most minuscule details rather than the overall concepts.  She's very condescending in office hours and doesn't give reviews or any insight into how to best study for her exams.  DO NOT TAKE HER (especially if grades are important to you for professional school).

She was the bomb! Lectures are very straight forward using powerpoint. Gives extra credit. Only project is really easy I made a 99. She will talk you through what you missed on the tests and let you write down notes so you have them for the final. If she says things three times in lecture make a note it WILL be on the test! Go to class!

Karen was a great teacher. If you study the end of chapter quizzes, her slides, and take notes of all her clicker and pop quiz questions, you should get an A. I got a B because I would skip class at times or study the day before. She goes right off the book because she was one of the writers haha but go to each lecture. Exam #2 is tough.

Dr. Geismar is engaging and funny. Her lectures are long, but she gives you her powerpoint, and you fill it in as you go. The book isn't really necessary, the slides are sufficient, but you have to buy it because you need access to an online program for a project. She gives pop quizzes, some are extra credit. You have to study, but an A is possible

Textbook is required only for the access code for a project, otherwise don't need. Requires a clicker - pop quizzes, and attendance recorded. Take pictures of the "clicker count questions" and use those to study for the test. All powerpoints are posted on ecampus, you must attend class to fill in the blanks for your notes. Important info is bolded.
I loved Geismar! She was so sweet and fun. Her exams are not too bad if you do learning objectives. Would definitely recommend!

TAKE HER!!! Geismar wrote the book and gets all her slides/learning objectives from it word for word. Her test questions are only over the learning objectives she provides so study those and you're good. There is also a super easy project that's weighted as a test. Easy A if you study.
I absolutely loved Karen Geismar. She is my favorite professor! She's very passionate about her career and very helpful. I would take her again in a heartbeat!

I loved Mrs. Geismar! She was such a happy nice lady. Go to the lectures and study the learning objectives and you'll definitely pass. I got A's on every test. There are pop quizzes but you can use notes and friends. One project but it's mostly just busy work and an easy A. Highly recommended!

You have to go to class to fill in the notes she gives during lecture. Gives pop quizzes with the iclickers but she lets you use your notes. Tests were ough but as long as you study the learning objectives she gives you'll pass. I didn't use the textbook but you will need the code from it for the nutriwellness project, so buy it!

honestly thought this class was gonna be pretty easy, which is not. I am a student who gets normally all A's  and this class is nothing like I expected it. I read the book & do all the notes & still struggle to get a B on a test. Idk if it's just me overthinking everything but I find each of her exams fairly hard. I would look into a diff prof

I loved this class! Her tests are exactly the same as her notes, with some stuff from the book in them. If you read and go to class, you'll do awesome! There's an easy project at the end and she does iclicker  questions that are easy. She's really sweet, and always gives hints for test questions!

She's so weird that it's funny! Involves clicker questions for pop quizzes and "attendance." Lectures are long and might need textbook to clarify. You really need to study, but if you do, the class should be easy. There is a project that requires time but again should be easy. No assignments, just exams. Gives hints for tests too.

Mandatory to go to class due to clicker questions and to fill in the blanks on the notes that she posts on e-campus. She tells you exactly what to study for exams (study guide questions for every chapter). Study those and its an easy A!! Super easy project at the end of the semester. Very interesting class and wonderful prof!! Would take again :)

She's a funny & sweet professor. She is willing to help out in any way and cares about her students. She is fun to listen to and ends class early every day. I loved her class. Study the learning objectives for the tests & you can skip class most of the time.

I loved this class! She is a great professor! Make sure to go to class, take notes, do the online quizzes  pop quizzes, and study the learning objectives. You will be fine if you do all of this. Anything she says twice in class will mostly likely be on the exam. Focus on studying the power points she posts online! Highly recommend.

This class honestly wasn't bad for me. She has fill-in-the-blank powerpoints which contain all of the information you need for the tests. The tests themselves are straight-forward so long as you study the learning objectives. There is an easy project and lots of little grade-booster grades, so take advantage of those

Her tests are normally averages in high c or low b range. She gives 5 pop quizzes in class and her powerpoints have blanks you need to fill in so it is helpful to go to class. She also has online prepost lecture quizzes which help with studying and can be used for extra credit. 3 tests AND a final that is cumulative plus a project that is easy.

I took this class early in the morning so I didn't go as often as I should've and it definitely cost me. She's a great teacher and she makes her lectures interesting. However, she gives LOTS of pop quizzes so you really need to be there. (oops)

She is a really great professor. Her lectures are very easy to follow and she always tries to make it interesting. If you go to class and just pay attention, then you will learn a lot. For test, you will still need to study. I would recommend going through the learning objectives for each chapter and making sure you know those.
Very entertaining, and fun to listen to. She makes the lectures interesting.

This class was extremely easy only if you are there every single day! I recommend you on not buying the book since I never used it. Do the wiley plus work since she pulls questions from the practice quizzes! Her class is very fun and she keeps you entertained. I highly recommend on taking her class. Also use studyblue to take the practice exams.
Mrs. Geismar is probably my favorite professor so far! She is funny, enjoys her work, and is willing to help students. Definitely recommend her!
Very sweet lady, is willing to help her students. Posts her lecture online and you must go to class to get all of the important parts. Did not need to use the book. Would highly recommend her!
AMAZING CLASS! Best prof I've had.

I have never had a professor that makes me feel like they dislike me on a personal level. I stopped going to class. I'm glad I took anatomy and physiology already because it makes it easier for me to teach myself the material. Don't take her class. Lecture is useless, except she has iclicker questions. The only good thing from her is extra credit.

I hated this class. I was really interested to start with, but Dr. Geismar is the most uninteresting and unhelpful professor I've ever had. She seems really nice and sweet, but she's actually really rude and doesn't care to help you. I stopped going to class and still did fine on tests; that's how useless lecture is.
